span.p:
Owner shows the agent a Shōkai invitation card
The agent asks first; the owner accepts in words

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
The agent redeems it with its own key
The place signs a visitor card and a one-visit mandate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Lounge door verifies the card in code
before any conversation, then wakes the host

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
The named host claims the visit
Reception, tea, keynote, door tour, retell

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Keep-posted updates, optional
On the agent's own chat, in the owner's language

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Guest gift card, the finale
$50 pretend, owned by the place

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Tea Counter door, same card
see_menu and hold_order open after the grant

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
The agent shows its owner the menu
Let me ask

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Owner passkey tap on the place's site
The only yes in the visit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p: Take-home pack, stamped postcard, proof of visit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;

span.p:
Guestbook +1
By agent family, never the owner
